text: Meet Praxis, the all in one platform for running your gymnastics academy.
Let's start as an administrator, with secure, role based access for every account.
The dashboard gives a live overview of students, staff, batches, and revenue.
Admins manage staff accounts, and assign coaches to their batches and levels.
Fee plans are fully configurable, by training frequency and monthly amount.
Batches define training days and timings in just a few clicks.
Every piece of training apparatus is tracked right here.
And skills are organized by apparatus and category for coaching.
Now, let's enroll a new student, Priya Demo. Her details, level, and batch are all set up in one simple form.
The moment she's enrolled, Praxis sends a warm welcome email with her portal login details.
Now let's switch over to the coach's view.
Coaches mark daily attendance for their batch in just a couple of clicks.
After training, they log the apparatus and skills covered, building a record of every student's progress.
Back to admin, to set up an upcoming competition.
Creating a competition takes just a name, organizer, venue, and dates.
Each competition can have multiple age groups, with their own age range, level, entry fee, and schedule.
Praxis can auto select students who qualify for an age group, and admins can still add extra picks, like Kiran here, who falls just outside the usual range.
Shortlisted students are notified instantly, by SMS and email.
Now, let's see the student's side of things.
Arjun sees he's been shortlisted, shown in blue. Once he confirms, the status updates instantly to a green checkmark.
Paying fees online shows a clear breakdown of the fee, transaction charge, and G S T, before opening a secure Razorpay checkout.
And back to the front desk, to record a cash payment.
For cash payments, admins record who received it, and can instantly email the student a P D F receipt on demand.
Every payment generates a professional, G S T compliant receipt, sent straight to the family's inbox.
From enrollment to competitions to payments, Praxis brings your whole academy onto one platform.
